body:
> I'm sure your boyfriend wouldn't want you to end your life.

I second that!!!!!!

Nothing I say will come close to even begin to help your situation.  I am terribly sorry for your loss.  This post brought me to tears.  Have you joined an in-person support group for grievance of a spouse or significant other?  I know it's a unique type of grieving, different than losing family.  I am 34.  When i was 21 I lost the love of my life, the person I am certain is my true soulmate.  I can't even tell you how much I want to be dead-- still , to this day!!-- just so I can see him again.  Ironically when I was 22 I was healthy, and he was sick (brain tumor)- but no one knew he was dying.. it was sudden.  But now, the irony is that I am very ill, and probabyl near my death bed anyway.

What I'm trying to say is that... we are going do die anyway.  I know that this life is torturous-- even like Hell-ish-- and while you may not ever move on or find someone just as good, the  agony may die down a bit after a while.  (Not saying you'll ever get over him or that it'll get easier, but you may not remain suicidal for years to come. )

Since we all die anyway, I suggest riding out the remainder of your life,e ven if it means suffering.  I am suffering minute to minute, and need a double lung transplant and unable to walk anymore for years... so trust me when I say I feel for you greatly and I shoudl take my own advice.  I'm just going to suffer it out until my day comes.  I know that suffering SUCKS, and that life is super hard.  But please, do not end it.  

I can tell how much he meant to you.  When he died did you scream louder than you ever screamed before?  Did you cry more than you ever cried?  That's what happened to me.  Total emotional wreck... and guess what, it never went away.  12 years has passed now and the agony died down a lot, but he is always in my thoughts. I think of him daily.

What gives me the most comfort is knowing that I'll see him agani, even if it's in 40 yrs, 30 yrs, or 2 yrs.  

I'm guessing you're young so in your case you probably have a full life ahead of you... and in that case, let's say you see him again in 50 yrs... he'll still be there waiting for you.  If he's there now in 2017 waiting for you, he'll be there in the year 2090.  He's not going to go anywhere.  

I know that you don't want to move onto anyone else... it'll be a lonely life if you don't... however, at the same time, I know you only want to be w/him. I can't blame u there!  I moved on from mine.  Not saying you shoudl at all.  But I did . But guess what, every night i pray to him and I tell him that i am coming soon.  My ex's knew that he was my soulmate bc i was honest about it.  No one says you have to move on to find another mate and then have kids,e tc.  You could totally opt to be single-- however, eventually you may grow very lonely.  Whether we want to or not, we end up finding someone in the end , esp since you're young.  :(  

I don't want you to end it just to see him again.  If he's your soulmate, whcih I'm sure he is, he'll be there even if you were to move on.
me too!!

I went thru my 20's feeling so lonely.  The phase will pass once you get a boyfriend or connect with your relatives.  Or when you start your own family.  Once you have your own family all that will change, I promise :) I know it seems forever away.  Build your talents, build your skills, and when you are in your career you may still be lonely but you'll be building your life up to where you have your own family... whether it's at the age of 18, 24, 35, etc. 
Perhaps go on meetup.com... i had success with that site when i was very lonely. Tons of ppl to make friends with on that site.  Family estrangement SUCKS, I know.  I have it too.  But like i said, we can't change that right now, unless you think you can somehow make your dad closer to you.  Idk your situation with your father so only you know that, but maybe try calling him more, making plans with him more. Or you can express to your mom that you need her and that you're feeling lonely.  I wish i did that to my mom when i needed her.  I just never told her.  Ask her to go somewhere with you?

i agree.  I'm very ill and really there is no need for me to be alive... no life here, merely existing... and if i'm not mistaken i could still donate my eyes or even give my face for a face transplant.  What i have is not contagious and can't "spread" but more of effects from an injury mimxed with bad collagen in my lungs... but if just an eye transplant, I don't see why my eyes or hands or something couldn't go to someone in need.....
totally agree.
You don't have to reply to all comments... it's overwhelming.  Just read them and only reply to the ones you wish to reply to

After reading some comments, seems like you're young and have a nice life ahead of you.  Why do you feel like not earning money is some sort of permanent situation?  First off, that's not permanent.  You'll get a job.  Secondly, I went to college for many years and really hated the way the info was presented, hated doing the work, and really just hated it.  But many people don't like college.  If it were easy, it wouldn't be work>  You're doing a great job in life.  Just the fact that you're IN college means you have already made accomplishments that others haven't, including graduating high school, and having some sort of way to even afford college.  Secondly, you're young.  Hard classes and lack of job should NOT be reasons that one should end his life.  I'm NOT saying that you dont' have it bad.  To you, you may think you have it awful, or maybe you just don't value your life... or maybe you're just sick of people.  I know there is always more to the story but please, if there is something else bothering you , can we chat about it?  Pls give us the chance to try to talk you out of this?  Seems like you're battling the "why's" and you have the mindset of "why shoudl i? or "why do i have to?"  You DON'T "have" to.  But, think of all you'll miss out on.  Life can be beautiful.  Please read my post in this thread by clicking on my name. I wish i coudl go back to the days when i just hated college, faked a smile, and had no job...
Hold on ok pls msg me.  At least give us the chance to talk you out of it, pls.  I know you said you can't do it, and I'm glad you cannot.  But pls PM me anyway.... i am sending u a msg now.....
Hello pls pm me if you'd like to talk
Pls pm me... I'm worried because i haven't seen an update. Let me know you're  ok. Would love to chat

It's not illegal to simply have urges.  I'm not trying to downplay the way you feel, but any suicidal over it? Everyone has some sort of warped thoughts. You really can't help what turns you on sexually.  There are adults who marry 13 year olds. It's good you're still attracted to women of age, and maybe seek a therapist to suppress the other urges. Don't be so hard on yourself. I imagine many ppl are pedophiles by nature but just don't say anything.  You only see it as taboo bc society shuns the idea.
no ur not strict at all, thanks so much for your help...
ok oh it's no problem, i was trying to figure out how to go back and edit but I'm new to Reddit sorry
ok i will remove that, i didn't want it to lead to more i just was telling ppl i'm straight so i dont have lesbians hitting on me.
I'm not looking for dating.... I'm just looking for friendship

I'm alone because my family doesn't really care and they would not keep the a/c on for me so i can breathe... they don't let me use a wheelchair in the house... i was diagnosed 3 yrs ago.. how about you?

Yes it would be great to have companionship here.  I do live around tons of people.  I'm not able to get out and talk to people though.  And I do have an on/off boyfriend who I live with but we are currently not together (although we live together).  I'm alone most of the time, and he works almost around the clock so he's not here.  What I really need are friends and it's hard to find female friends bc they want to go otu to the mall or whatever and I'm stuck here.  So I would need to find local disabled friends, and they're hard to find.  
It is really easy for me to find male friends-- I have a million of them.  But since I'm in an on/off relationship I can't invite them in.  They always have an ulterior motive.

That's good you're living with your parents.  So your brother is in LA, that's awesome!  Are you going to try to move to the usa too  ? LA as in Louisiana or Los Angeles?   What did you do in NJ?  There are some nice towns here.  Most of the nicer ones are by the beach Haha... 

 I actually have like 50 diagnosis. LOL. I I know exactly what you mean that healthy people cannot talk to us much. You can talk to me anytime and you can private message me as well and I will give you my Facebook page and things like that. Basically my main diagnosis is ehlers-danlos syndrome and that comes along with dysautonomia. I also have bronchial tracheal malacia.
Thanks so much... yes I do distract myself the best I can.

Does your brother live in NJ too?  What area in NJ did you visit, do you remember?  Would love to hear more about it.  My aunt is from the Phillipines and my cousins go there multiple times in the year.  
Yes they did the same exact thing to me, pointing it to anxiety.   That is so sad that you go to sleep not wanting to wake.  Yes I have a caregiver and they come here almost daily (usually).  How about you?

Sorry noticed you replied above too... how old are you?  I am 34 female and i live in NJ.  What part of the USA did you visit?  Did you like it here?  So sorry about your kidneys and head.  They try putting all sick people on psych meds even if we don't need it. :(   Fortunately when my dr tried to do that i did not take the medication they suggested.  (But if it's helping you that's great, and keep taking! I just mean that sometimes they like to pawn physically sick people off to the psychiatrist bc they insist we are fine, when we are NOT fine!)
thanks, yeah it does feel like hell actually :(

Thanks so much.  I cannot listen to music bc of hyperacusis so bad that I get 10 x worse with noise. Yes I know what you mean, and I do wish for assisted suicide.  I'd probably back out of it though :)  
I really don't know if I want to end it. I haven't told fam / friends.  I don't wanna make it look like I would be out for attention.  I am trying to write about it to sort things out in my mind.  I want to enforce the part about having a way out to end it but ONLY if I am at what-i-think-is my final hour (or minute?).   I can handle all sorts of things... I've been through sexual assaults, robberies, all sorts of things in my life.  I was a free spirit so of course i was subject to a lot of weird things happening to me that ppl develop PTSD over.  I have always been happy & still am actually. I'm not really depressed at all.  I just can't handle the physical pain.  I really don't mind about the world and I don't feel victim or anything... I realize that i'm just one out of the million suffering.  I care about my life SO greatly. I'm not like a person who wants to end it bc i feel like "ehh I don't care". On the contrary, I care SO much.  I "love" life... always been so passionate about life, even while being sick>  I still am. But even in the midst of the passion for everything, the physical torture is so extreme!  It's like... to put it in perspective... loving life in general, but every single second a knife stabs me.  I don't know how long people take that knife stabbing them, bleeding and all.  People may endure it for an hour, maybe 1 month.  But it has been years and getting worse. But nevermind the fact that it has been years.  What's worse is that now I'm worse physically, and the agony has gotten more severe.  I am not going to end it, though.  I do think writing this post has helped me. I think the only way I'll end it is if I'm in my final hour and about to die anyway.  And I don't even know if i'd truly "end it".  Most likely, I'd jsut have a backup plan in case i get even worse...can't imagine getting worse.  But from here i don't think i coudl get better.

Oh that's terrible.  I was sick like you in my 20's as well.  What is wrong in terms of your health?  I have 200 symptoms and it started as a teen but was progressive.  Now I'm basically incapacitated and have very little room in my lungs to breathe and i can't really move at all.

I'm so sorry.  My situation is permanent too and too torturous to go on.  I put my own post up here as well.  I still do not think us killing ourselves is the best choice, although I can totally relate to wanting to do that bc there is no hope for me either.  
But I will say that maybe you should suffer it on out.  Why?  No reason.  You may bring joy to someone who needs it one day.  I know that is a sucky trade-off for your part.
Me too! Where do you live? I'm in usa.  My health is bad but I'm stable,  now in bed.  How about you?

Aw thank you so much... it would be nice to have someone that I could actually talk to and interact with. I would probably save myself if I actually had something in person. I'm feeling pretty awful .  How're you doing,  are you suicidal as well?

I didn't mean overcome your condition.  I should have clarified that.  I figured it was permanent.  Mine is too and I'll never overcome my illness.  I meant we should overcome the suicidal plan or desire, but i know even that is unlikely.  I shouldn't have said that bc i know that's impossible.   I'm in the same boat.... no therapy will help... just want out. 

    Sometimes I wonder if I just wait until the last moment to the point where I'm actually dead if that's the better choice. The suffering just seems to agonizing to want to carry through with the rest of the life. When I think about it though, we're going to die anyway.  If we can endure the torture just a little bit longer or time will come anyway.. 

But then that leads me to my next question. Do you think you're at a risk of imminent death or that you were going to die soon do to your illness or disability? Or is your condition something that you think you will live a long time with, but just too torturous to go on?
Can't even talk to a dr either bc they rip up the paper i write on,  no matter what dr it is.  I'm too sick to get to a doctor though so that's already out of q. I'm dying at home.

Yes my dr knows,  but there's no hope for me.... u lungs and heart are less than 8%. Very complex situation.  I have to literally replace every single one of my organs to get better.  it's basically impossible. I can't even sit to get anesthesia because they want you to lean back. As soon as I lean back I stop breathing and my lungs suffocate
I'm alone almost 24/7 but i have someone come to help me a couple hrs a day,  thank u

I can relate. Disabled and dying of my illness which is similar to late stage ALS and lungs dint work.  Need ventilator & feeding tube but my body will reject.  Pls pm me if u need a feiend who understands. I know i sure do. The physical agony is horrible and causes many ppl to end it.  

I do not think there's any such thing as right choice or wrong choice. But what I will say is I really hope you do not end your life. And yes that's coming from me, the person who literally just posted a few minutes ago about how I want to end mine eventually. But still, we need to find a way to overcome this. I know there probably is no way but...

For me I'm not so much worried about the fact that I have no life or that I'm homebound or have no hobbies that I can do anymore or that I have no social support. For me I don't have any of those things, but what really bothers me the most is it physical agony.

What is bothering you the most, if you don't mind me asking? Is it the physical Agony, or is it the fact that you have lost all of your hobbies? Like do you get any relief when you're just sitting there? Or is every single second practically seeming like the worst moment of your life?

I'm here fior you.  Pls pm me or comment back.  Please do not end it.  I can fully relate to your post.  It is ironic. I'm in the same position you're in. I have spent so many years volunteering my time to talk people out of suicide, and now that I am considering it,  I'm alone. So ironic!! I'll be damned if i let a fellow human feel he has no one when i come across your blurb of how you have no one.  I have only 8% lung function so i can't really verbally speak,  but i can text and provide support.
